title: New 'Paranormal Activity' Returns to the Original House
excerpt: The eighth Paranormal Activity is set in the house from Oren Peli's 2007 original. Ian Tuason directs for Blumhouse and Paramount, in theaters May 21, 2027.
content:
The next Paranormal Activity is moving back into the house where the franchise started. The eighth film is set in the same home Oren Peli used for his 2007 original, a detail that came out of Blumhouse’s BlumFest panel at New York Comic Con on Friday. Dread Central’s Brad Miska reported it and said he had independently confirmed the same thing.

No plot or character details have been released, so whether Katie and Micah are anywhere near this one is still unknown. Ian Tuason directs, with Chase Yi, Sonia Mena (Tell Me Lies) and Maya da Costa (Girls Like Girls) in the cast. Paramount has it in theaters on October 22, 2027, moved there from May 21 in November 2026.

Tuason Made His Own Debut in His Own House

Tuason’s first feature, undertone, went out through A24 in March. He shot it in his childhood home in the Rexdale neighborhood of Toronto, the house where he had looked after his dying parents. Co-star Nina Kiri told TheWrap the location was “very personal to Ian — so sacred, because it’s like his full life on the line.”

Peli made the 2007 Paranormal Activity in his own house as well. A series that began with a man pointing a camcorder around his own house has handed its eighth entry to a director who built his first feature exactly the same way.

A $15,000 Movie That Made $193 Million

Peli made the original for about $15,000 and it took roughly $193 million worldwide. James Wan and Jason Blum produce the new one through Blumhouse-Atomic Monster, Peli produces through Solana Films, and Paramount is co-producing and co-financing.

Wan told The Hollywood Reporter in January that he had “been a huge admirer of Paranormal Activity since the brilliant first movie” and was “looking forward to expanding on its legacy and helping shape the next evolution of this scary found-footage franchise.” A Blair Witch reboot is on the 2027 calendar as well, which puts both of the films that turned found footage into a commercial genre back in theaters inside the same year.

The last entry, Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin, went to Paramount+ in 2021. This one is going back to a theater, and back to the room it started in.
